title: Forward and backward scan result
statement: Given sets $A$ and $\Gamma$, two transition functions $\delta_f,\delta_b:A\times\Gamma\to A\times\Gamma$, an initial state $a_0$, and a finite word $w$ over $\Gamma$, first run $\delta_f$ from $a_0$ across $w$. Then run $\delta_b$ from the resulting state across the reverse of the first output word, and reverse the second output word. The result is the final state together with that reversed output.
hypotheses_covered: Forward and backward transition functions from a state and symbol to a new state and symbol
